thread:
prod-alert-bot: Pager — S1: Elevated 5xx spike detected from inference-gateway -> model-pool (us-west1). Error rate 8.2% (5m window). Routing/Envoy suspicion. Paging SRE oncall and ingress eng. Graph: https://grafana.redwood/d/alert/xyz123

sre-oncall: ack @prod-alert-bot @ingress-eng paging. I'm on it. Can someone post earliest traces + any recent deploys? ETA 2m.

ingress-eng: looking now. Topline: large number of 502/504 from envoy upstream, concentrated to pool/model-pool-v2. Spike timeline starts ~2025-06-10T03:42:00Z. No gateway code deploys in last 24h.

alice: joined. Quick glance at envoy access logs show retries applied (x-envoy-retry-count: 3) and lots of `upstream_reset`/`503`. Could be retry amplification + downstream latency.

mohit: pulling config: route for /v1/infer has `retry_policy` with `retry_on: 5xx,gateway-error,connect-failure` and `num_retries: 3`. Also found circuit_breakers for that cluster: `max_connections: 200`, `max_pending_requests: 10`. Low pending could be bottleneck.

sre-oncall: immediate mitigation proposal: disable retries at gateway for that route and increase `max_pending_requests` to 100 to avoid immediate rejections. Who can push a hotfix to envoy route config?

ingress-eng: I can. Plan: apply a configmap patch to set `num_retries: 0` on the route and bump `max_pending_requests`. Rolling restart of envoy daemonset. Command I'm prepping:
```
kubectl -n ingress patch configmap envoy-config --type merge -p '{"data": {"routes.json": "..."}}'
kubectl rollout restart daemonset/envoy -n ingress
```
I'll post diffs to /tmp before apply.

runtime-eng: note: removing retries will reduce amplification but will expose errors upstream; we should inform support and CS. Also consider weight shift as short-term traffic steering if one pool is unhealthy.

prod-alert-bot: Deploy-bot: starting rolling config patch to ingress envoy config (jobs queued: 8).

alice: applying patch now. Local diff (sanitized):
```
- "retry_policy": {"num_retries": 3}
+ "retry_policy": {"num_retries": 0}
... "circuit_breakers": {"max_pending_requests": 100}
```
`kubectl apply -f /tmp/envoy-hotfix.yaml`

ingress-eng: patch applied, rolling restarts started. Watching health checks and traffic.

sre-oncall: dashboards: error rate dropping from 8.2% -> 3.1% within 2m. Latency: slight increase in tail latencies as errors surface. Good initial sign.

mohit: additionally pushed a temporary route weight change to move traffic away from model-pool-v2 (v1=80, v2=20) while we stabilize. This is a short 10m mitigation.

runtime-eng: confirmed weight change applied. Observing backend latency on v2 is elevated; v1 looks healthy.

alice: customer impact note: preliminary calc shows ~12% of queries to hosted API in us-west1 returned 5xx between 03:42-03:50 UTC. Most affected were free-tier background jobs; one enterprise customer saw a brief spike but no prolonged outages. Logging attached to the incident ticket.

sre-oncall: filing internal incident INC-2026-358 with timeline, actions, and links to dashboards/logs. Assigning follow-ups to platform and ingress teams. Tagging support and CS for customer comms.

support-bot: Support: created internal case #4321. Draft customer message prepared — CS to review for impacted customers.

ingress-eng: during rollout we had one envoy pod restart due to a config validation error (bad JSON in a replicated stanza) but it self-healed. Not related to core change. Will include in post-incident notes.

mohit: initial RCA thoughts: brittle circuit breaker thresholds + aggressive retry policy created amplification loop when a subset of upstream hosts slowed. Action items: add automated config canary for retry/cb changes, add alerting for retry-amplification patterns, audit cluster CB values.

sre-oncall: followups and short-term checklist: 1) revert traffic weight after 15m if stable; 2) run config audit and safety checks; 3) update runbook with concrete commands used here; 4) add a Grafana panel for retry amplification. Handoff time: handing to @alice for post-incident monitoring. I'm standing down from active command.

alice: ack taking ownership for next 6 hours. I'll keep watch and update the ticket. Scheduling a 1hr postmortem tomorrow to capture action items.

prod-alert-bot: Incident state -> watch mode: error rate returned to baseline ~0.7% after mitigations. No further automated pages.

sre-oncall: thanks team. I'll add the follow-up tasks to INC-2026-358 and assign owners. Good quick mitigation: disabling retries + traffic steering prevented further cascade.

alice: I'll draft the postmortem and include the exact kube/envoy commands and the config diffs in the ticket. Thanks all :heart:
